title: Clear a Claude shell move left pending at turn start
outcome: Round-15 review (Claude, tm-winf steps 2+3). A Claude command that sets EngramShellDirectory.pending but never reports its end on the same runtime token (an interrupted turn without a tool_result) leaves the move pending; every later command then gets None from engram_command_directories, so no check is kept (and its commands count as writing in every worktree) until a later cd re-places the shell or the runtime restarts. engram_note_turn_started does not clear it. Fix direction: at turn start, drop a pending move and lose the shell (the command may have run its cd), so an absolute cd can re-place it; add a test.
